dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: How do you like it here?

dialogues.speaker: Yaoyao
dialogues.text: Hehe, oh, this is much livelier than my place, but it also isn't quite the bustling hive of activity the wharf is.

response.speaker: Yaoyao
response.text: Of course. Oh c'mon, you don't have to worry about me.

response.speaker: Yaoyao
response.text: You see, Master has taught me that "when in an abode, do as the adepti do"... Um, wait, I think it's "the guest should go along with their host"...

response.speaker: Yaoyao
response.text: But whatever the case, I love it here!

response.speaker: Yaoyao
response.text: I just hope I'm not imposing...

response.speaker: Yaoyao
response.text: I—If you don't mind, I'd like to stay here a little longer.

response.speaker: Yaoyao
response.text: And... you know, accompany you for a while.

response.speaker: Yaoyao
response.text: No, no, that's not what I mean.

response.speaker: Yaoyao
response.text: This place is just like an adeptus's abode — I feel welcomed and comfortable here.

response.speaker: Yaoyao
response.text: It's an honor to be invited over to play.
